items.title: GPT‑6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
items.title_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 与「智能 UI」，安全回退问题被点名
items.title_en: OpenAI launches GPT-6 with 'Intelligent UI', safety regressions flagged
items.summary: OpenAI announces GPT-6 with a redesigned 'Intelligent UI' for everyone, prompting extensive Hacker News debate over its interface design, image quality versus GPT-5.6, and safety regressions noted in the accompanying system card.

items.title: Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2026 to Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai
items.title_zh: 2026年诺贝尔化学奖授予Kagan与Soai，表彰不对称催化研究
items.title_en: Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2026 Goes to Kagan and Soai for Asymmetric Catalysis
items.summary: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded to Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai for work on asymmetric catalysis and autocatalysis, prompting discussion on chirality and its role in biology.

items.title: Margaret Hamilton has died
items.title_zh: 阿波罗软件负责人玛格丽特·汉密尔顿逝世，享年89岁
items.title_en: Margaret Hamilton, Apollo Software Lead, Dies at 89
items.summary: Margaret Hamilton, Apollo software lead and computing pioneer who coined the term 'software engineering', has died at 89.

items.title: Shipping JPEG XL in Chrome
items.title_zh: Chrome 正式支持 JPEG XL，推翻此前的弃用决定
items.title_en: Chrome Ships JPEG XL Support, Reversing Earlier Deprecation
items.summary: Google is shipping JPEG XL support in Chrome, reversing its earlier deprecation and, combined with Firefox's imminent stable rollout, bringing the format to majority browser coverage.

items.title: Navier–Stokes Lost in Translation
items.title_zh: 论文质疑 LLM 的 Navier–Stokes 爆破 Lean 证明与原文不符
items.title_en: Paper Challenges Fidelity of LLM's Lean Proof of Navier–Stokes Blow-up
items.summary: A paper argues that an LLM's formalized Lean proof of Navier–Stokes blow-up fails to match the original natural-language argument, sparking debate over whether a headline AI mathematics result is overstated.

items.title: Quoting Jake Boggan
items.title_zh: 研究者感慨：Barnette 猜想疑似被 OpenAI 的 Lean 数学项目解决
items.title_en: Researcher reflects as Barnette's Conjecture appears solved via OpenAI's Lean math project
items.summary: A Hacker News commenter reflects on the bittersweet news that Barnette's Conjecture — which he pursued for 24 years — appears to have been solved, apparently through OpenAI's Lean-formalized math project.
